raw_text: China-Linked Influence Campaign Deployed Deepfakes, Fabricated Polls to Interfere in Taiwan Election. Recorded Future's Insikt Group has documented a multi-platform influence operation linked to Chinese state actors targeting Taiwan's January 2024 presidential election. The campaign leveraged AI-generated deepfake videos of DPP candidates, fabricated opinion polls, and Spamouflage-network accounts to promote KMT candidates and amplify fear narratives about cross-strait conflict under DPP governance.
